title: "Politics and business"

## The Dáil

44 women were elected to the Dáil at the 2024 general election, 25% of all TDs. The share has roughly doubled since the 1990s, when about one TD in eight was a woman.

{{< chart gender-dail >}}

## Business

Women's share of senior roles in large companies has grown since 2019, but remains below half. In 2025, women held 28% of board seats, 19% of chief executive roles and 32% of senior executive roles.
